ACCEPT

Your question is useful and Socratic because it focuses on the core reasoning process needed for accurate biological problem-solving. By asking about the "specific type of reasoning" to demonstrate, you guide the model toward structured thinking—such as deductive reasoning using biological principles, elimination of implausible options, or connecting concepts to real-world mechanisms—which reduces guessing and reinforces conceptual application. This aligns well with maximizing accuracy in MMLU tasks.
